name: Temple Chicken Sandwiches
notes: A special occasion sandwich, frequently served on outings to the Oakland temple. Marta named this sandwich, and requested it for her wedding luncheon.

items: 2 cups pre-cooked chicken breast, cut into ¼” × 1 × 1” cubes
Artichoke marinade, enough to make the mixture spreadable

steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.body: Mix together **4 oz cream cheese**, **2 oz herbed goat cheese**, **2 cups pre-cooked chicken breast**, cut into ¼” × 1 × 1” cubes, **1 cup marinated artichoke hearts**, chopped, and artichoke marinade (enough to make mixture spreadable).

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve on good bread with romaine lettuce and grape tomatoes.

yields: About 3 cups filling, enough for about 6 sandwiches (estimated)
